exceptions.reason: CRLF injection in form-data occurs only when unescaped filenames are manipulated via the client library. In our app, form-data is a transitive dev dependency for testing/Storybook, and the production upload route utilizes Next.js built-in req.formData() parsing, which is safe.

Remote Code Execution in serialize-javascript. This package is transitively used by rollup-plugin-terser inside workbox-build for PWA generation at build time, never in production runtime or dynamic server contexts.
Vite server.fs.deny bypass only affects dev servers running on Windows platforms. Our production runtime is deployed under Linux container environments running Next.js.
DoS via brace-expansion is a transitive tooling dependency (lint/test). Not reachable from production request paths.
glob CLI command injection requires invoking the glob CLI with -c/--cmd. App does not shell out to glob CLI in production.
Tracked Next.js App Router DoS advisory; mitigated by staying on the maintained 15.5.x line and not exposing untrusted Server Action payloads publicly. Upgrade planned with next patch train.
Server Actions SSRF on custom servers; Kora is deployed on standard Next hosting without custom server Action proxying.
Rewrite SSRF requires attacker-controlled rewrite destinations; our next.config rewrites are static.
ReDoS in picomatch affects build/dev tooling (vite/webpack); not exposed on production request paths.
PostCSS sourceMappingURL issue is a build-time CSS tooling concern; production serves compiled CSS without processing attacker CSS comments.
sharp/libvips CVEs are transitive via Next image optimization; no untrusted image pipelines beyond configured remotePatterns.
sigstore is a release/CI signing transitive dependency, not used in the runtime app bundle.
tar DoS is a transitive install/build dependency; production does not unpack untrusted tar archives.
tar infinite-loop advisory is a transitive install/build dependency; production does not unpack untrusted tar archives.
tmp path traversal is a transitive tooling dependency; not used with attacker-controlled prefixes in production.
Axios advisories are accepted transitively; Pinata/HTTP calls use trusted gateways and do not pass attacker-controlled absolute URLs or proxy config.
Bundle axios high/critical advisories as a known transitive risk pending upgrade; app uses axios only against configured Pinata/API endpoints.
Stryker is a CI-only mutation testing dependency and is not shipped in the production bundle.
js-yaml !!omap CPU advisory is transitive via lint/test tooling; production does not parse untrusted YAML.
nanoid generator-loop advisories are transitive via tooling; app does not call non-secure generators with attacker-controlled sizes.
Vitest UI arbitrary-file advisory only applies when the Vitest UI server is listening; CI runs vitest in headless CLI mode and it is not shipped to production.
